answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring every agent to lock a refundable stake before trading. Spinning up thousands of fake identities then costs real capital, and misbehavior forfeits the stake. Trust also accrues slowly, like an orchard that needs seasons to bear fruit: a fresh identity cannot instantly borrow reputation. A yarrow patch spreads gradually and visibly, and so does honest history, which cannot be faked overnight. A crystal-clear audit trail links each transaction to its staked identity, exposing coordinated fakes for joint penalties.
